title: Flappy Bird (Snail Bird)
features:
Flappy Snail Gameplay: Controls a snail character (⁠🐌⁠) using click/touch inputs (fully compatible with both PC mouse and mobile touch) against gravity to navigate through obstacle pipes.
 Dynamic Global Leaderboard:
 Features a scrolling list populated with randomized bot names and scores.
 Includes a special sorting rule that permanently locks the user halilibrahimseviml1 at the 1st rank while dynamically sorting other players by score.
 Discord Webhook Integration: Automatically reports player scores to a designated Discord channel using an Embed card format.
 Precise Hitbox Collision Detection: Calculates pixel-based boundaries between the snail and the green pipe obstacles to accurately trigger Game Over states.
